record.question: Grievous injury includes :
record.explanation: Held: the printed page confirms these four options without an all-inclusive option or further qualification. Under section 116 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, applicable in 2026, emasculation is expressly grievous hurt, while permanent loss of sight or hearing and permanent facial disfiguration also qualify; the latter three options omit permanence. Emasculation is the strongest literal choice, but the broad wording does not resolve whether the other choices mean their permanent forms, leaving the intended single answer ambiguous. Source: https://www.indiacode.nic.in/bitstream/123456789/20062/1/a2023-45.pdf
